name: Folsom Prison

features.name: Toast Bet
features.description: 20% extra cost for an assured scatter on reel 2.

review:
A prison where the reel area grows as you play. The optional Toast Bet costs 20% more and guarantees a scatter on reel 2 – scatters only appear on the middle rows of reels 2 to 5.

Three scatters start eight or more Walk the Line spins, and the Cockroach Nest is a second kind of wild. xWays and xSplit expand the ways. Insane volatility, 75,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
